primary_goal: Primary: improve durable family financial security through prudent financial planning and evidence-led validation of a low-capital AI-assisted income opportunity (Project 500). The Trading Agent remains a secondary, paper-only research option and must never be assumed to generate income.
success_condition: The family's financial plan is grounded in actual income, expenses, obligations and liquidity, without assuming any trading profits.
Project 500 produces evidence-based keep/change/stop decisions for specific customer-problem hypotheses before paid build-out.
A bounded paid pilot is a target only if real customer demand and legal/operational prerequisites are demonstrated; no income outcome is guaranteed.
Long-term wealth-building choices are evaluated separately from speculative trading.
Any later trading contribution requires robust reproducible out-of-sample and holdout evidence across the existing formal gates before deployment consideration.
Any later trading withdrawal logic is based on realized P&L after required reinvestment and risk reserves.
Full auditability is preserved through provenance, immutable reconciliation and durable evidence records.

financial_intent.withdrawal_basis: realized P&L after required reinvestment and risk reserves
financial_intent.reference_capital_scope: Legacy trading research simulation only; not actual available funds.
financial_intent.user_statement: Exactly EUR 500 are available as Project 500 capital; no more capital is available. These funds are not trading capital.

operating_principles: Project 500 and family financial resilience are the primary strategic priority; trading is secondary.
Evidence before interpretation; explicit separation of sourced fact, inference and hypothesis.
Validate real customer pain and willingness to pay before building or spending.
Use free sources and tools first; assume zero discretionary spending until the stated €500 liquidity is clarified.
Prefer cheap falsification, small reversible experiments and human review over speculative full automation.
No income, customer demand, trading edge or date-specific outcome is guaranteed.
Coverage and PIT before trading performance.
More compute may accelerate useful work but may never relax scientific or safety gates.
Historical capability receipts and current live resource availability must remain separate states.
Maximize useful work without artificial work, duplicate work or runtime padding.
Persist durable goals, decisions, progress and continuity in canonical repository layers so subsequent chats can resume without relying on transcript memory.
source_of_truth_role: Defines project intent only. Technical truth remains current public master; scientific truth remains ledger, checkpoints and workflow evidence.

current_strategy.name: Project 500
current_strategy.objective: Discover and validate a practical AI implementation and employee enablement service for SMEs, beginning with a tightly scoped, human-reviewed workflow pilot and current evidence of customer demand. Only €500 total Project 500 capital is available; the trading system remains secondary and its capital remains zero actual trading capital.
current_strategy.core_offer: KI-Startklar-Pilot: train up to five employees and implement one low-risk workflow, with a tailored guide, human verification checklist, pre/post measurement and short follow-up; legal/compliance certification is excluded.
current_strategy.ai_act_claim_guard: Never promise AI Act compliance or imply a mandatory standard certificate; sell practical AI literacy and safe workflow implementation only.

budget_gates.minimum_evidence: at least five interviews support a recurring unsolved problem
